issues.title: God Object: server/routes.ts (1109 lines)
issues.description: The routes.ts file is a God Object with 1109 lines, 70 functions, max complexity 43, and 16 dependencies. It handles messages, streaming, analytics, health checks, metrics, error handling, request validation, and response formatting.
issues.impact: High - Difficult to test, hard to maintain, high risk of bugs, violates Single Responsibility Principle
issues.recommendation: Split into 5 route modules: messages.ts, streaming.ts, analytics.ts, health.ts, and middleware.ts

issues.title: Circular Dependency: server/index.ts ↔ server/routes.ts
issues.description: Circular dependency between server initialization and routes modules causes initialization issues and tight coupling.
issues.impact: High - Initialization issues, tight coupling, difficult to test
issues.recommendation: Extract shared types, break the cycle by using dependency injection

issues.title: God Object: cli/bin/claudeflow.ts (739 lines, complexity 94)
issues.description: CLI entry point has 739 lines with complexity 94 in setupCommands function. Handles CLI initialization, command registration (14 commands), argument parsing, help text generation, and error handling.
issues.impact: Medium - Difficult to test individual commands, hard to add new commands
issues.recommendation: Extract command registration to separate module (command-registry.ts)

issues.title: God Object: parsers/request-parser.ts (893 lines, complexity 38)
issues.description: Request parser is too large with multiple responsibilities: request validation, message parsing, content parsing, tool parsing, and system message parsing.
issues.impact: Medium - Complex parsing logic, difficult to test edge cases, hard to extend
issues.recommendation: Split into focused parsers: message-parser.ts, content-parser.ts, tool-parser.ts, validator.ts

issues.title: God Object: parsers/response-parser.ts (904 lines, complexity 24)
issues.description: Response parser handles response parsing, stream parsing, chunk parsing, usage parsing, and error parsing in one large file.
issues.impact: Medium - Similar issues to request-parser.ts
issues.recommendation: Split into focused parsers: stream-parser.ts, chunk-parser.ts, usage-parser.ts, error-parser.ts

issues.title: Inconsistent Naming Conventions (106 instances)
issues.description: Mixing camelCase and snake_case throughout codebase. Found 106 instances of snake_case variables (max_tokens, stop_sequences, tool_choice, cache_control) mixed with camelCase.
issues.impact: Medium - Reduces code readability and consistency
issues.recommendation: Use camelCase for all internal variables, only use snake_case when directly interfacing with external APIs

issues.title: Magic Numbers (47 instances)
issues.description: 47 magic numbers found throughout codebase including retry configuration (3, 1000, 10000, 2), quota thresholds (0.9, 0.8, 0.1, 0.5), and performance weights (0.2).
issues.impact: Medium - Difficult to understand intent, hard to maintain
issues.recommendation: Extract all magic numbers to named constants with explanatory comments

issues.title: Magic Strings (28 instances)
issues.description: 28 magic strings found including role names ('user', 'assistant'), provider names ('kiro', 'anthropic'), and cache control types ('ephemeral').
issues.impact: Medium - Type safety issues, potential typos
issues.recommendation: Use enums or constants for all magic strings

issues.title: Unnecessary Comments (89 instances)
issues.description: 89 instances of comments that explain WHAT the code does rather than WHY, adding no value.
issues.impact: Low - Code clutter, maintenance overhead
issues.recommendation: Remove obvious comments, keep only WHY comments

issues.title: Long Parameter Lists (8 functions)
issues.description: 8 functions with more than 5 parameters, making them difficult to use and maintain.
issues.impact: Low - Difficult to use, error-prone
issues.recommendation: Use configuration objects instead of long parameter lists

issues.title: Infrastructure Initialization - No Error Handling
issues.description: initializeInfrastructure() has no try-catch around Promise.all([qdrant.connect(), redis.connect()]). Unclear error messages on startup failure.
issues.impact: High - Unclear error messages on startup failure
issues.recommendation: Add try-catch with detailed error messages for each service

issues.title: Health Check - No Error Handling
issues.description: healthCheckAll() throws on any health check failure instead of returning partial status.
issues.impact: High - Health endpoint fails completely instead of showing which services are down
issues.recommendation: Use Promise.allSettled() and return partial status

issues.title: Streaming Handler - No Error Handling
issues.description: handleStream() generator function has no try-catch around event processing. Stream interruption without cleanup causes potential memory leaks.
issues.impact: High - Stream interruption without cleanup, potential memory leaks
issues.recommendation: Add try-catch around event processing with proper cleanup

issues.title: Kiro Auth - Missing Try-Catch
issues.description: Multiple async Redis operations in kiro-auth-manager.ts without error handling: selectAccountFromCombo(), rotateAccount(), initializeCombosFromRedis().
issues.impact: Medium - Errors propagate without context, difficult to debug
issues.recommendation: Add try-catch to all async Redis operations

issues.title: Inconsistent Logging
issues.description: Mix of console.log/error and structured logging across infrastructure, streaming, and auth modules.
issues.impact: Medium - Difficult to debug, inconsistent log format, can't aggregate logs
issues.recommendation: Replace all console.log/error with structured logger

issues.title: Missing Retry Logic for Infrastructure
issues.description: No retry logic for transient failures in infrastructure connections (Qdrant, Redis, Voyage API).
issues.impact: Medium - Startup failures on temporary network issues
issues.recommendation: Add retry logic with exponential backoff for infrastructure connections

issues.title: Missing Custom Error Types
issues.description: Only 1 custom error type (KiroMitmError) exists. Need 20+ custom error types for proper error discrimination (AccountError, ConfigurationError, InfrastructureError, StreamingError, ParsingError).
issues.impact: Low - Generic error handling, unclear error sources, difficult to handle programmatically
issues.recommendation: Create error hierarchy with 20+ custom error types

issues.title: CLI Module Completely Untested (0% coverage)
issues.description: Entire CLI module has 0% test coverage. 14 commands (16 command files + 5 service files + 5 utility files = 26+ files) are completely untested.
issues.impact: Critical - Major user-facing component is untested
issues.recommendation: Add comprehensive CLI tests for all 14 commands

issues.title: Overall Coverage Critically Low (25.42%)
issues.description: Overall test coverage is only 25.42% (line coverage), with branch coverage at 18.30% and function coverage at 22.15%.
issues.impact: Critical - Insufficient test coverage for production
issues.recommendation: Increase coverage to 80% target

issues.title: No Integration Tests
issues.description: No end-to-end or integration tests for critical flows: full request flow, Kiro authentication flow, session refresh flow, cache hit/miss scenarios, error recovery scenarios.
issues.impact: Critical - No integration testing
issues.recommendation: Add integration tests for critical paths

issues.title: Infrastructure Module Low Coverage (38%)
issues.description: Infrastructure module has only 38% coverage. Missing tests for connection initialization, error handling for connection failures, retry logic, and connection pooling.
issues.impact: High - Core infrastructure untested
issues.recommendation: Add infrastructure tests

issues.title: Config Module Low Coverage (55%)
issues.description: Configuration module has only 55% coverage. Missing tests for configuration validation, environment variable parsing, hot reload functionality, and default value handling.
issues.impact: Medium - Configuration errors not caught
issues.recommendation: Add config tests

issues.title: No Rate Limiting on Any Endpoint
issues.description: No rate limiting implemented on any endpoint. Vulnerable to DoS attacks, resource exhaustion, and cost explosion. All endpoints (API, admin, health) are unprotected.
issues.impact: Critical - Service unavailability, API quota abuse, financial loss
issues.recommendation: Implement multi-tier rate limiting: global (1000/min), API endpoints (60/min), admin endpoints (10/min)

issues.title: Permissive CORS Configuration
issues.description: CORS configured with origin: true and credentials: true, allowing ANY origin to make authenticated requests. Enables session hijacking, CSRF, and data exfiltration.
issues.impact: Critical - Session hijacking, CSRF, data exfiltration
issues.recommendation: Whitelist specific origins, restrict methods and headers

issues.title: No Authentication on Admin Endpoints
issues.description: Admin endpoints /admin/analytics and /metrics have no authentication. Anyone can access sensitive analytics and metrics data.
issues.impact: Critical - Information disclosure, privacy violation, competitive intelligence leak
issues.recommendation: Add API key authentication for admin endpoints

issues.title: No HTTPS Enforcement
issues.description: Server accepts HTTP connections without enforcing HTTPS. Session tokens and API keys transmitted in plaintext over HTTP.
issues.impact: High - Man-in-the-middle attacks, credential theft
issues.recommendation: Enforce HTTPS in production, add HSTS headers, redirect HTTP to HTTPS

issues.title: Plaintext Session Storage in Redis
issues.description: Session tokens and API keys stored as plaintext JSON in Redis. If Redis is compromised, all sessions and API keys are exposed.
issues.impact: High - Account compromise, unauthorized API access
issues.recommendation: Encrypt session data before storing in Redis using AES-256-GCM

issues.title: Sensitive Headers Logged
issues.description: Request headers including x-api-key and x-session-token are logged in plaintext. Secrets exposed in log files.
issues.impact: High - Secrets exposed in log files
issues.recommendation: Sanitize sensitive headers before logging

issues.title: Weak Query Parameter Validation
issues.description: Analytics endpoint has weak query parameter validation. No type validation, no sanitization, invalid date handling not caught, no enum validation.
issues.impact: Medium - Application errors, filter bypass, potential injection
issues.recommendation: Add comprehensive query parameter validation

issues.title: No Redis Authentication Enforcement
issues.description: Redis can be used without authentication in production. No validation that Redis URL includes password or uses TLS.
issues.impact: High - Unauthorized Redis access, session theft
issues.recommendation: Enforce Redis authentication and TLS in production

issues.title: No Memory Management in Streaming
issues.description: Streaming handler accumulates all content blocks indefinitely without cleanup. For long responses (10K+ tokens), this could be 40KB+ in memory with no cleanup after yielding chunks.
issues.impact: Critical - Memory leak potential for long responses
issues.recommendation: Implement sliding window for content blocks (keep last N blocks), add memory limit checks

issues.title: Missing Parallelization in Request Pipeline
issues.description: Request pipeline operations are sequential when they could be parallel. Cache check + classification (saves 100-200ms), context optimization + account selection (saves 10-20ms). Total potential savings: 110-220ms per request (26-30% reduction).
issues.impact: High - 110-220ms unnecessary latency per request
issues.recommendation: Parallelize independent operations using Promise.all()

issues.title: No Connection Pooling for External APIs
issues.description: No connection pooling for Voyage AI API, Qdrant REST client, or Anthropic SDK. Each request may create new TCP connection.
issues.impact: High - TCP connection overhead, potential connection exhaustion
issues.recommendation: Configure HTTP agents with connection pooling (keepAlive: true, maxSockets: 50)

issues.title: Synchronous Embedding Generation
issues.description: Embedding generation blocks request for ~200ms. No batch processing, no connection pooling, no circuit breaker.
issues.impact: High - 200ms blocking per cache check
issues.recommendation: Implement async queue with batching for embedding generation

issues.title: No Circuit Breaker Pattern
issues.description: No circuit breaker for external services. Continues trying even if service is slow/down, causing cascading failures.
issues.impact: High - Cascading failures when dependencies are slow/down
issues.recommendation: Implement circuit breaker using opossum library

issues.title: Fixed Cache Thresholds
issues.description: Cache optimization uses fixed thresholds (1024 tokens, 2000 tokens, 5 messages) that are not adaptive based on actual performance.
issues.impact: Medium - Suboptimal cache hit rates
issues.recommendation: Implement adaptive thresholds based on metrics

issues.title: No Retry Jitter
issues.description: Retry logic has no jitter, causing thundering herd problem when multiple clients retry simultaneously.
issues.impact: Medium - Thundering herd problem on retries
issues.recommendation: Add random jitter to retry delays: delay * (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5)

issues.title: Potential N+1 Queries in Analytics
issues.description: Analytics engine may have N+1 query patterns. Each metric might be a separate Redis call without batching.
issues.impact: Medium - Slow analytics queries
issues.recommendation: Use Redis pipelines for batch operations

issues.title: Missing Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
issues.description: No ADRs documenting key architectural decisions. Makes it difficult to understand why certain design decisions were made.
issues.impact: Medium - Difficult to understand design rationale
issues.recommendation: Create ADRs for 8-10 key decisions (pipeline architecture, Qdrant choice, Redis caching, etc.)

issues.title: Missing Troubleshooting Guide
issues.description: No troubleshooting guide for common issues. Users struggle to diagnose and fix problems.
issues.impact: High - Users struggle with common issues
issues.recommendation: Create comprehensive troubleshooting guide with common errors, debugging workflows, and log analysis

issues.title: Missing Performance Tuning Guide
issues.description: No performance tuning guide. Users don't know how to optimize for their workload.
issues.impact: Medium - Users can't optimize performance
issues.recommendation: Create performance tuning guide with benchmarks, tuning parameters, and optimization strategies

issues.title: Missing Security Best Practices
issues.description: No security documentation. Users may deploy insecurely.
issues.impact: High - Users may deploy insecurely
issues.recommendation: Create security guide covering API key management, network security, data encryption, access control

issues.title: Incomplete .env.example
issues.description: .env.example is missing optimization settings, Bedrock provider documentation, baseURL documentation, and Kiro combo configuration. Only ~60% of available configuration options are documented.
issues.impact: Medium - Developers unaware of available configuration options
issues.recommendation: Add all missing environment variables with descriptions

issues.title: Empty Accounts Array Default
issues.description: Default config has empty accounts array. Server will fail to start without at least one account, but error message is unclear.
issues.impact: Medium - Confusing error message for new users
issues.recommendation: Add startup validation with clear error message requiring at least one account

issues.title: Hot Reload Watcher Not Cleaned Up
issues.description: Hot reload watcher is not properly cleaned up. No way to stop watching or clean up resources. Memory leak if enableHotReload() called multiple times.
issues.impact: Medium - Potential memory leak
issues.recommendation: Add cleanup method and AbortController for proper watcher management
